dashboard.completeProfileBody: Finish onboarding so møni can calculate your daily calorie and macro targets.

logFood.title: Log food
logFood.describePlaceholder: e.g. 2 eggs, toast with butter, cappuccino
logFood.noFavoritesYet: Your regulars show up here once you star a meal.
logFood.permissionDeniedBody: møni needs the camera or your photos for this. You can allow access in Settings.
logFood.analyzeErrorBody: Your input is still here: try again or enter it yourself.
logFood.label: Nutrition label
logFood.quickLogError: Saving didn’t work. Nothing is lost; try again in a moment.

barcode.permissionBody: møni needs the camera to scan a barcode. You can allow it in Settings.
barcode.notFoundBody: We don’t know this product yet. Scan the nutrition label or enter it yourself.
barcode.hint: Point the camera at a barcode
barcode.frameA11y: Scan frame. Hold the barcode inside the frame.

review.title: Review
review.lowConfidenceNote: This is a cautious estimate. Take a quick look at the amounts.
review.noItemsBody: Add at least one ingredient before saving.
review.limitReachedBody: The free analyses for today are used up. Describing, barcode and regulars keep working.

paywall.title: Free analyses used up
paywall.body: The free analyses for today are used up. møni Premium analyses without a cap; describing, barcode and regulars keep working.

label.hint: Photograph the nutrition table on the package

notFound.title: Product not found
notFound.body: We don’t know this product yet. Photograph the nutrition table and møni will read it for you.

incomplete.title: No nutrition data
incomplete.body: This product has no nutrition values on record. Photograph the nutrition table on the package.

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: Product lookup isn’t reachable right now. Try again or enter the values yourself.

labelUnreadable.title: Could not read the table
labelUnreadable.body: No nutrition values were recognised. Hold the camera straight, close and well lit. This attempt doesn’t count toward your free analyses.

labelError.title: The analysis didn’t work
labelError.body: The nutrition table couldn’t be read. Nothing is lost; try again.

voice.title: Speak
voice.subtitle: Just say what you ate.
voice.example: For example: “Two eggs, a slice of toast with butter”
voice.editHint: You can still edit the text.

error.permission: For voice, møni needs the microphone and speech recognition. You can allow both in Settings.
error.unavailable: Speech recognition isn’t available right now. Just describe your meal as text.
error.noSpeech: I didn’t hear anything. Try again, a little closer to the microphone.
error.network: Can’t reach speech recognition. Check your connection and try again.
error.interrupted: The recording was interrupted. Try again.

recipe.createHint: Cook once, log often: with ingredients and servings.
recipe.logError: The dish couldn't be logged. Try again in a moment.

editor.addHint: Type amount and ingredient. Known items come from your history, new ones are estimated by møni.
editor.analyzeError: This ingredient couldn't be estimated. Enter it manually.
editor.limitReached: Today's AI estimates are used up. Pick ingredients from your history or enter them manually.
editor.saveError: Saving didn't work. Try again in a moment.
